title: Live-Action Look Back Film Screens in N. American Theaters on December 30
content: GKIDS announced on Tuesday that it will screen the live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot in select theaters in North America on December 30 followed by a wider release in theaters on January 15.
author: ANN

title: 'Murciélago' Reveals Main Cast, Additional Staff, Second Teaser, Winter 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kana Yoshimura 's Murciélago manga revealed main cast, additional staff, a teaser visual, and a second teaser promo on Wednesday. The anime series will premiere on Tokyo MX, Kansai TV, and BS11 in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Naruto Hypes Jump Festa With Cool Makeover Ahead of Anime Return
content: Naruto is planning to have a huge showcase during Jump Festa 2027 later this year, and the franchise is gearing up for the event with a cool makeover getting the characters ready for the anime and manga’s big comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Lord 2099 Novels End With 6th Volume
content: Kadokawa 's Fantasia Bunko imprint announced on Tuesday that author Daigo Murasaki and illustrator Kureta 's Demon Lord 2099 ( Maou 2099 ) light novel series will end with its sixth volume. Murasaki and Kureta released the first novel volume under Kadokawa in January 2021, and the fifth volume in November 2025.
author: ANN

title: One Piece English Dub Kicks Off Elbaph Arc With New Crunchyroll Release
content: Fans of the One Piece English dub release are in luck as the Elbaph Arc has finally kicked off its run with Crunchyroll with the first of its new weekly releases. One Piece returned for the Elbaph Arc earlier this year as part of a whole new era for the long running anime franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Creator Says Goodbye to Yhwach With New Look Ahead of Anime Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has finally put a decisive end to the anime’s final fight with the penultimate end of the series after 22 years , and the creator behind it all has shared a cool new look at Yhwach to help celebrate.
author: ComicBook

title: Compile Heart's Villion:Code Game Launches in West on January 26
content: The game will get a Digital Deluxe Edition that includes a digital art book and soundtrack. The PS5 version will have physical editions in North America and Europe, and the Switch and PS4 versions will get physical editions in North America.
author: ANN

title: South Park Surprises With the Perfect JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Shout Out – Watch
content: South Park is no stranger to fun anime shout outs and Easter Eggs, but the latest episode really went all out to show JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure some love with some very familiar poses. South Park Season 29 has made some big changes through its three episodes so far for the year.
